Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium vertical cinematic poster artwork
Primary request: Create a vertical 2:3 cinematic artwork inspired by two reference-image aesthetics, divided into two elegant sections with a refined, balanced transition.

Scene/backdrop: Portrait composition with a subtle horizontal division around the midpoint, unified as one premium poster. Top section is a realistic dreamy tropical island at night: a huge glowing golden full moon low behind tall silhouetted palm trees, a small warm wooden cabin with softly glowing windows and lights on the shore, calm dark ocean water reflecting moonlight, a small fishing boat with two tiny people, a few distant birds, and a peaceful star-filled sky. Bottom section is a beautiful hand-painted watercolor-and-ink illustration: a snowy mountain beside a calm lake, a golden full moon behind the mountain, a tiny boat with one person on the lake, and soft loose reflections in the water.

Style/medium: top half photorealistic cinematic night landscape with natural textures and atmospheric depth; bottom half delicate traditional watercolor wash with fine ink linework, handmade paper feel, elegant but restrained. Seamless art direction across both halves while keeping the medium contrast obvious.

Composition/framing: vertical 2:3 poster, clean centered hierarchy, generous quiet negative-space area near the central transition and/or upper side margins for minimal typography to be added later, no actual lettering. Keep the cabin, boats, people, palms, moons, mountain, and reflections small-to-medium so the image feels spacious and poetic. Avoid clutter and visual tangents.

Lighting/mood: peaceful, magical, contemplative, dreamy moonlight atmosphere; warm golden illumination in the top scene, cool blue-white moonlit tones in the bottom scene, subtle cinematic glow, gentle haze, crisp focal detail, soft reflections.

Color palette: top charcoal navy, deep teal, amber-gold, warm wood; bottom icy blue, slate, pale cyan, soft white, muted gold.

Materials/textures: subtle premium paper texture across the poster, refined grain, watercolor pigment variation in the lower section, realistic water sheen in the upper section, polished art-poster finish.

Text (verbatim): none; leave a tasteful minimal typography area with no visible words.

Constraints: one full moon in each section; top must remain realistic and bottom must remain watercolor/ink; composition must be balanced, serene, highly detailed, and clean; no logos, no watermark, no border text.

Avoid: extra moons, extra boats or people, busy shoreline, oversized objects, harsh neon colors, cartoon styling in the top scene, photorealism in the bottom scene, legible text, logos, signatures, watermark, collage seams, distorted anatomy.
